name: Almond Pudding
description: Historical recipe from The Virginia Housewife; Or, Methodical Cook (1824). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: orange flower water or rose water
ingredients.originalText: orange flower water or rose water

ingredients.name: four crackers or two gills of rice flour

instructions.text: Put a pound of sweet almonds in hot water till the skin will slip off them
Pound them with a little orange flower or rose water, to keep them from oiling
Mix with them four crackers, finely pounded, or two gills of rice flour
Add six eggs, a pint of cream, a pound of sugar, half a pound of butter, and four table-spoonsful of wine
Put a nice paste in the bottom of your dish, garnish the edges
Bake it in a moderate oven

source.author: Mary Randolph
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put a pound of sweet almonds in hot water till the skin will slip off them
2. Pound them with a little orange flower or rose water, to keep them from oiling
3. Mix with them four crackers, finely pounded, or two gills of rice flour
4. Add six eggs, a pint of cream, a pound of sugar, half a pound of butter, and four table-spoonsful of wine
5. Put a nice paste in the bottom of your dish, garnish the edges
6. Pour in the pudding
7. Bake it in a moderate oven
